title: Retro TV Emulator Progress
author: RetroTVEmulator
selftext: Good test and its been a minute since i updated my progress so im sharing a video. Only saw a few bugs in there. Once i fix those and retest i plan on starting on the greyed out options like GPU support, Server support, and Update support. Ive added a lot since last update and reworked almost every part to run smoother and work better. Got all the static options put in for a retro tv feel. I think its coming along and welcome anyone that wants to help on this free to use open source project. even if its just testing and helping find bugs to fix. check out he discord where you can grab a test copy, get updates on the project, or even help fix/add some stuff. [https://discord.gg/YW4R4sdjr](https://discord.gg/YW4R4sdjr) if we can get some ppl that know a little more then i do, i would feel more comfortable adding in more game consoles for ppl with better computers now that im adding in GPU support.
